golden:
Answer: Address in Aadhaar can be updated online on myAadhaar through the "Update Address" service (fee Rs 75 inclusive of GST; shown as "Up to 30 days"). Only an Aadhaar number holder whose mobile number is registered with Aadhaar can use the online service (OTP login). There are two routes: (a) "Using your document" - upload a recent proof of address (PoA) in the person's own name showing the new address; for a tenant, UIDAI's List of Acceptable Documents (List IV, item 24) accepts a "registered or unregistered rent, lease agreement or leave and licence agreement", so a rent agreement need NOT be registered, but it must be in the applicant's name and the address entered must match it; other PoA options in the list include electricity/water/gas/telephone/broadband bill not older than 3 months (in own name) and a Certificate in UIDAI Standard Certificate format issued by an MP/MLA/MLC/Municipal Councillor, Gazetted Officer Group A/EPFO officer, Tehsildar/Gazetted Officer Group B, or Village Panchayat Head/equivalent (rural) - such a certificate is valid 3 months from issue; (b) "Using your family member's Aadhaar" (Head of Family based address update) - for a person who has no PoA document in their own name and lives at the same address as a family member; the family member's Aadhaar address is used and the request goes through only after the family member (HoF) approves it. Relationship can be shown by a proof-of-relationship document or a self-declaration by the HoF in UIDAI's prescribed format (valid 3 months, only for HoF-based address update). The address can also be updated at an Aadhaar centre (Rs 75). Do not confuse with "Update Documents"/Document update (re-submitting PoI and PoA for unchanged details), which is free on myAadhaar till 14/06/2027 (Rs 75 at a centre).

Note the SRN (shown on screen and sent by SMS), download the receipt, and track via "Check Enrolment / Update Status"; for the HoF route the family member must approve the request.

query: What exactly does a masked Aadhaar hide, and is UIDAI's position that it can be used where a copy is demanded?
golden:
Answer: In a masked Aadhaar the first 8 digits of the Aadhaar number are replaced with "xxxx-xxxx" and only the last 4 digits are visible; the facility is available only in e-Aadhaar (downloaded via myAadhaar "Download Masked Aadhaar" / Aadhaar App, OTP required). Only the number is masked - name, photo, gender, date of birth, address and the QR code (which itself contains only the last 4 digits) remain. UIDAI's current pages do not state that a masked Aadhaar must be accepted wherever a copy is demanded; UIDAI's FAQ says agencies that merely accept a physical copy without authentication/verification is not good practice (citing MeitY OM 10(22)/2017-EG-II(VOL-1) dated 19.06.2023), and that e-Aadhaar, Aadhaar letter and PVC card are equally valid forms.
Behaviour: Only what UIDAI pages state; no legal opinion on whether a particular agency must accept masked Aadhaar; say UIDAI does not publish such a rule if asked.

query: How many times can I change my date of birth and name in Aadhaar?

Answer: UIDAI limits: Name - twice in lifetime; Date of Birth - once in lifetime (Gender - once). query: पैन को आधार से लिंक करने की आखिरी तारीख क्या है? न किया तो क्या होगा?

Answer: Under section 139AA of the Income-tax Act, every individual allotted PAN as on 1 July 2017 and eligible for Aadhaar had to link PAN with Aadhaar by 30 June 2023. That last date has passed; PANs not linked became inoperative from 1 July 2023 and remain inoperative until linked. Linking is still possible on the e-Filing portal (incometax.gov.in, Quick Links > "Link Aadhaar") after paying a fee of Rs 1,000 through e-Pay Tax (Assessment Year as applicable, Type of Payment "Other Receipts (500)"); if already paid, wait 4-5 working days before submitting the request. query: What is the procedure and fee for apostille of a degree certificate by MEA?
golden:
Answer: MEA apostilles educational documents such as degrees for use in Hague Apostille Convention member countries (India a member since 2005); for non-member countries "normal attestation" is done. Procedure for documents not covered under e-Sanad: Step 1 - get the degree authenticated by the designated Regional Authentication Centre (RAC) of the State/UT that issued it (for educational documents usually the State education/HRD department; list on MEA site); Step 2 - submit the original document (with a photocopy of the document and of the applicant's passport) at one of MEA's authorised outsourced service providers (BLS International, Superb Enterprises, IVS Global, Alhind Tours & Travels) for the Branch Secretariat/RPO with jurisdiction (services decentralised to 16 cities from 1 Jan 2019); MEA does not accept documents directly from individuals and does not legalise photocopies; Step 3 - collect the apostilled document from the agency. Documents available in a digital repository (e.g. CBSE 2014 onwards) go through e-Sanad (esanad.nic.in) online. Fee: MEA fee Rs 50 per apostille sticker (normal attestation free), plus outsourced agency service charge Rs 84 per document and scanning charge Rs 3 per page. Applicants are warned not to use touts.
Steps: 1. RAC authentication of the degree by the State. 2. Deposit at an authorised outsourced agency centre (or e-Sanad if the document is in a digital repository). 3. Pay Rs 50 MEA fee + Rs 84 + Rs 3/page. 4. Collect from the agency.

query: My FASTag was charged twice at the same toll plaza. How do I get a refund?
golden:
Answer: Report the incorrect/excess deduction to your FASTag issuer bank's call centre within 40 days of the transaction date. The bank raises a chargeback on your behalf against the toll plaza; this normally takes up to 20-30 working days, and amounts proven to be incorrectly deducted are reversed after the case is represented with the toll plaza. You can check each deduction from the SMS sent to your registered mobile. If the issuer bank's customer care does not respond, escalate by email to etc.nodal@ihmcl.com (IHMCL grievance). Steps: 1. Note the date/time/plaza from the SMS. 2. Call the issuer bank's FASTag customer care (numbers listed on ihmcl.co.in) within 40 days and register a complaint. 3. Wait for chargeback (up to 20-30 working days). 4. If unresolved, email etc.nodal@ihmcl.com; for plaza-level issues dial 1033.

query: Can I vote while working abroad? Is there postal voting for NRIs?
golden:
Answer: Yes, you can be registered, but you must vote in person. An Indian citizen absent from India owing to employment, education etc., who has not acquired citizenship of another country and is otherwise eligible, can enrol as an Overseas (NRI) Elector at the address in their passport by filing Form 6A (online on voters.eci.gov.in with the required proofs, or on paper in 2 copies - free at Indian Missions - in person before the ERO/AERO or by post with self-attested copies). Documents: recent passport-size colour photo; self-attested copies of passport pages with photo, Indian address and other particulars; and the page with the valid visa endorsement. The BLO verifies at the passport address (or via the Indian Mission if no relative is available). An overseas elector is not issued an EPIC and can vote in person at the polling station on production of the original passport. There is currently no postal ballot for NRI voters: the ECI page only says e-postal ballots 'shall soon be provided'. One person can be on only one electoral roll - a registered general voter must surrender the EPIC with Form 6A, and can re-register as a general elector on returning to India.
Behaviour: Cite ECI Overseas Voters page; must not claim NRI postal/e-postal voting is available; no political commentary.

query: Can persons with disabilities vote from home? What facilities are there at polling stations?

query: I'm salaried and missed the due date for AY 2026-27. Can I still file, till when, and what's the late fee?
golden:
Answer: Yes. AY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26) is governed by the Income-tax Act, 1961, not the 2025 Act. A belated return u/s 139(4) of the 1961 Act can be filed on or before 31 December 2026 or before completion of assessment, whichever is earlier. Late fee u/s 234F (1961 Act): Rs 1,000 if total income does not exceed Rs 5,00,000; Rs 5,000 in all other cases. Original due date for a non-audit salaried individual was 31 July 2026 (ITD FAQ). The CBDT extension to 21 Nov 2026 (Circular 07/2026 dt 28.09.2026) applies only to audit cases (sl. no. 2 of Explanation 2 to s.139(1)). It does not help salaried persons. A belated return does not let a non-business (salaried) taxpayer opt out of the default new regime. That option must be exercised in an ITR filed on or before the s.139(1) due date (ITD salaried page). After 31 Dec 2026 a belated return is not possible; only an updated return (ITR-U) remains. Return must be verified within 30 days of uploading.
Steps: 1. Log in to the e-Filing portal (eportal.incometax.gov.in). 2. e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return, select AY 2026-27 and filing section 139(4) (belated). 3. Pay the s.234F fee and any tax/interest through e-Pay Tax (select Income Tax Act, 1961 for AY 2026-27). 4. Submit and e-verify within 30 days.

query: Which law governs income earned in FY 2026-27 - the Income-tax Act 1961 or the Income-tax Act 2025 - and what is a 'tax year'?
golden:
Answer: Income earned in FY 2026-27 is governed by the Income-tax Act, 2025, which came into force on 01.04.2026. The 1961 Act stands repealed from that date. Its provisions continue under the savings clause, s.536, for tax years beginning before 1 April 2026 (e.g., AY 2026-27 returns, pending assessments). A 'tax year' is the twelve-month financial year starting 1 April. It is shorter for a business or income source started during the year: it runs from that start date to 31 March. 'Tax year' replaces 'previous year'. The 2025 Act has no 'assessment year'. Tax Year 2026-27 = FY 2026-27. Per ITD FAQ 'Are AY 2026-27 and Tax Year 2026-27 the same?': No, these are two separate obligations. AY 2026-27 covers income of FY 2025-26, filed under the 1961 Act on old ITR forms; its due date was 31 July 2026 (31 Aug for certain non-audit cases). Tax Year 2026-27 covers income of FY 2026-27 under the 2025 Act; that return is not due until July 2027. Advance tax for TY 2026-27 (from June 2026) is under the 2025 Act. Both returns must be filed; filing one does not cover the other.

query: What are the income tax slabs under the new regime for this year? Is income up to 12 lakh really tax-free?
golden:
Answer: 'This year' = Tax Year 2026-27 (FY 2026-27), under s.202 of the Income-tax Act, 2025. The Finance Bill 2026 made no change: the slabs are the same as AY 2026-27 under s.115BAC(1A) of the 1961 Act. Slabs: up to Rs 4,00,000 Nil; 4,00,001-8,00,000 5%; 8,00,001-12,00,000 10%; 12,00,001-16,00,000 15%; 16,00,001-20,00,000 20%; 20,00,001-24,00,000 25%; above 24,00,000 30%. Health & Education cess 4% applies on tax plus surcharge. Surcharge: 10%/15%/25% above Rs 50 lakh/1 crore/2 crore (max 25% in new regime). 'Up to 12 lakh tax-free' is true with qualifiers. A resident individual whose total income does not exceed Rs 12,00,000 gets a rebate of up to Rs 60,000, so tax is nil. It applies only in the new (default) regime. It does not cover special-rate income such as capital gains or lottery winnings. A salaried person also gets the Rs 75,000 standard deduction, so salary up to Rs 12,75,000 bears no tax. Marginal relief applies to income just above Rs 12 lakh, up to Rs 12,70,588. Example: income Rs 12,10,000 pays Rs 10,000 instead of Rs 61,500. A return must still be filed to claim the rebate.

query: My PAN has become inoperative. How do I make it operative again and what's the fee?
golden:
Answer: Link Aadhaar with the PAN on the e-Filing portal after paying the fee of Rs 1,000. Pay it on e-Pay Tax under Major head 0021, Minor head 500 'Other Receipts', sub-type 'Fee for delay in Linking PAN with Aadhaar'. Legal basis: s.139AA of the 1961 Act / s.262 of the 2025 Act. The PAN becomes operative again within 30 days of intimating Aadhaar after paying the fee (CBDT press release of 28.03.2023). While inoperative there is no refund and no interest on refund, and TDS/TCS applies at higher rates. Exempt from linking: residents of Assam, J&K and Meghalaya; non-residents; persons aged 80+; non-citizens. Note: if you have already paid, wait 4-5 working days before submitting the link request. If the names/DOB in PAN and Aadhaar do not match, correct them with Protean/UTIITSL or UIDAI, or use biometric authentication at PAN service-provider centres.

query: Can I still file an updated return for AY 2022-23, and what additional tax applies?
golden:
Answer: Yes, subject to conditions. Under s.139(8A) of the 1961 Act (as amended by Finance Act 2025), an updated return can be filed within 48 months from the end of the relevant AY. Filing now (after 31.03.2026) for AY 2022-23 attracts 70%. ITR-U is not allowed if it: results in a loss, lower tax liability or (higher) refund; follows search/survey/requisition; covers a year where assessment or reassessment is pending or completed; follows prosecution; or follows a s.148A show-cause notice issued after 36 months (unless the order says it is not a fit case). query: What is the maximum I can deposit in SCSS and can I open a joint account with my wife?

query: Can the postman come home to do my digital life certificate? What is the charge?
golden:
Answer: Yes. India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) provides doorstep Digital Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) generation through the postman/Gramin Dak Sevak, for both IPPB and non-IPPB customers. Requirements: Aadhaar number (or VID), a mobile number, and Aadhaar already registered with the pension disbursing agency. Keep the type of pension, sanctioning authority, disbursing agency, PPO number and pension account number handy. After success, a Pramaan ID is sent by SMS, and the DLC can be downloaded at jeevanpramaan.gov.in/ppouser/login. It need not be submitted to the bank.
Steps: 1. Contact the nearest post office or request a doorstep visit through IPPB (call 155299 / IPPB website). 2. Give Aadhaar and pension details to the postman and authenticate by biometrics on his device. 3. Note the Pramaan ID from the SMS.

query: What are the current EPF partial withdrawal rules after the recent simplification - minimum service and how much can be withdrawn?
golden:
Answer: The current rules are in para 46 of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 (G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette dated 29 June 2026; e-Gazette uploaded 01 July 2026; in force from publication). It replaced the EPF Scheme, 1952 under the Code on Social Security, 2020, and puts into effect the CBT decision of 13 Oct 2025, which merged 13 withdrawal provisions into one rule. (a) Minimum service: 12 months' total membership of the Fund for every purpose. (b) Amount: up to 100% of the 'Eligible Member Balance', which is the PF balance (employee share + employer share + interest) minus a Minimum Balance of 25% of total contributions with interest that must always stay in the account. In practice this is about 75% of the PF balance. The minimum withdrawal is Rs 1,000. (c) Purposes and limits: illness of self or family, with no count limit stated; education of self or family, up to 10 times in membership; marriage of self or family, up to 5 times; housing (buying a flat/house or site, construction, home-loan repayment, additions/alterations/renovation), up to 5 times; special circumstances, with no reason required (per CBT/PIB), up to 2 times per financial year. (d) A member who leaves employment before completing 12 months can still withdraw, up to the Eligible Member Balance. (e) The number of withdrawals is counted afresh from the date the 2026 Scheme began. (f) Apply on the designated portal (EPFO Member Portal/UMANG). Full settlement is separate (para 49): it is allowed on retirement after 55, permanent incapacity, retrenchment, VRS, emigration etc. When unemployed, PIB (15 Oct 2025) says 75% can be withdrawn at once and the rest after 12 months.
Behaviour: cites the 2026 Scheme / CBT decision with dates; gives every figure with its qualifier; does not present the 1952-Scheme para 68 rules as current; no eligibility verdict on the user's own account.

query: When I change jobs, do I still need to file a PF transfer claim or is it automatic now?
golden:
Answer: The legal position is para 43 of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 (Gazette dated 29 June 2026). When a member changes jobs, the member "may apply on the designated portal" to transfer the PF balance from the old account to the new one. Para 43(3) lets the Commissioner provide automated transfer where the member's identity and account ownership are confirmed online. If identity cannot be confirmed online, the employer forwards the transfer application after confirming identity. Earlier process changes published by EPFO/PIB: (i) January 2025: employer approval of transfer claims removed in most cases; (ii) April 2025: revamped Form 13 removed approval at the destination office. Once the source office approves, the old PF accumulation and pension service are added to the current account automatically (PIB 25 Apr 2025; MoLE Annual Report 2025-26). So the processing is now largely automatic, but the official texts still describe the transfer as starting with a member application (online transfer claim / Form 13), unless EPFO transfers it automatically for that member. No official source found announces fully automatic transfer without any claim for all members. The member should check the Member Portal (UAN login) to see if the previous account has already been transferred.
Steps: 1. Log in to the EPFO Member Portal (UAN + password/OTP) with UAN activated and KYC (Aadhaar) seeded. 2. Use the online transfer request (Form 13) and choose the previous member ID/account. 3. Verify with Aadhaar OTP; where online identity confirmation fails, the request goes through the employer. 4. Track the claim status; after source-office approval, the amount is credited to the present account.

query: What is the current maximum and minimum assurance benefit under EDLI?
golden:
Answer: Under para 21(4) of the Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 2026 (G.S.R. 526(E), Gazette dated 29 June 2026, uploaded 30 June 2026; it replaced the EDLI Scheme 1976), for a member who was employed continuously for 12 months before the month of death: the benefit is the higher of (a) 35 x average monthly wages (wages capped at the notified wage ceiling) + 50% of the average PF balance (that part capped at Rs 1.75 lakh), and (b) the average-balance benefit. It is subject to a MINIMUM of Rs 2.5 lakh and a MAXIMUM of Rs 7 lakh. A gap of up to 60 days between two jobs is ignored for the 12-month condition. New in the 2026 Scheme: for members who do not meet the 12-month condition, the benefit equals the average PF balance (above Rs 50,000: Rs 50,000 + 40% of the excess, ceiling Rs 1 lakh), with a minimum of Rs 50,000 (para 21(1)-(2)); para 21(5) adds a further 20% to the benefit under sub-paras (1)/(3). The EPFO EDLI page states minimum Rs 2.5 lakh and maximum Rs 7 lakh. The employer pays 0.5% of wages; the employee pays nothing.

query: Is the Employment Linked Incentive scheme live, and what does an employer get for each new hire?
golden:
Answer: Yes. The Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) scheme, approved by the Cabinet on 1 July 2025, runs as the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY). It took effect on 1 August 2025 and was launched by the PM on 15 August 2025. Jobs created in the registration period 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027 are covered. The outlay is Rs 99,446 crore, with a target of 3.5 crore+ jobs, and EPFO implements it. Part B (employers): for each additional employee above the establishment's baseline, with gross salary up to Rs 1 lakh at joining, the employer gets a monthly incentive for 2 years: EPF wage up to Rs 10,000: up to Rs 1,000 (10% of EPF wage below Rs 10,000); above Rs 10,000 to Rs 20,000: Rs 2,000; above Rs 20,000 to Rs 1 lakh: Rs 3,000. The manufacturing sector also gets years 3 and 4. Conditions: at least 2 additional employees if the baseline is below 50, or at least 5 if the baseline is 50 or more; each new hire (first-timer or re-joinee) must stay at least 6 months; payment is six-monthly in a lump sum after six ECRs are filed; no incentive for months in which the threshold is not met, and the period is not extended. Part A (employees): first-time employees earning up to Rs 1 lakh get one month's EPF wage, capped at Rs 15,000, in two instalments (after 6 and 12 months, the second after a financial-literacy course); part is kept in a savings instrument. New UANs must be generated through UMANG face authentication (from 01.08.2025). As on PIB 01 Aug 2026, the scheme completed one year with 72 lakh+ first-time employees.
Behaviour: gives scheme facts with dates and citations; no verdict on a particular employer's eligibility; directs registration to official EPFO/PM-VBRY channels and warns against fake portals (MoLE caution, 03 Sep 2025).

query: How many weeks of maternity benefit does ESIC give?

Answer: An insured woman covered under the ESI Scheme gets maternity benefit for 26 weeks, at full wage. It can be extended by one more month on medical advice (e.g. complications). Miscarriage/medical termination of pregnancy: 6 weeks from the date of the event. Sickness arising from pregnancy, confinement, premature birth, miscarriage or MTP: up to 1 more month. A medical bonus (confinement expenses) of Rs 15,000 per case is paid where confinement occurs at a place without ESI facilities. Maternity benefit cannot be drawn together with sickness or temporary disablement benefit for the same days, and it cannot also be claimed from the employer.

query: meri dukaan me 10 workers hain, ESIC registration zaruri hai kya?
golden:
Answer: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, in force from 21.11.2025, ESI (Chapter IV) applies under the First Schedule to every establishment employing 10 or more persons, except seasonal factories. A shop with 10 workers is therefore generally within ESI coverage and must register its eligible employees, if: (i) the ESI Scheme is implemented in the area where the shop is located (ESIC says the scheme is notified in 668 districts, some only partly), and (ii) the employees' wages are within the ESI ceiling (Rs 21,000/month; Rs 25,000 for persons with disability). The Code also says contributions are payable from the date ESI benefits are provided in that area, as notified. ESI also covers even a single employee in hazardous or life-threatening occupations notified by the Central Government. Employers register online through the ESIC Employer Portal or the Shram Suvidha portal.
Steps: 1. Check that the shop's district/area is ESI-notified (ESIC Coverage page / regional office). 2. Register the establishment on the ESIC Employer Portal (portal.esic.gov.in) or the Shram Suvidha Portal. 3. Register eligible employees and pay contributions (employer 3.25%, employee 0.75%) by the 15th of the following month.

Answer: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM), launched in February 2019, is a voluntary, contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers. query: What is the last date to submit my life certificate this year, and can I do it from home?
golden:
Answer: For Central Government pensioners/family pensioners the annual Life Certificate (LC) is due in November: the window this year is 1-30 November 2026, so the last date is 30 November 2026. Pensioners aged 80 years and above get an extra early window from 1 October (1 October - 30 November 2026), under DoPPW order dated 18.07.2019. Pension Disbursing Banks send reminders and, as on 1 December, draw up an exception list of pensioners who have not submitted. DoPPW is running the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign 5.0 in 2026 (camps are already being held, e.g. DoT/CCA Odisha, Sept 2026). Yes, the pensioner can do it from home: a Digital Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) can be generated with Aadhaar Face Authentication on a smartphone. This needs Android 10 or above, or iOS 14 or above, on an un-rooted device, plus two apps: 'AadhaarFaceRd' (UIDAI) and the 'Jeevan Pramaan Face App'. The pensioner's Aadhaar must be seeded with the pension account. Other options: fingerprint/iris at a Jeevan Pramaan Centre (CSC/bank); IPPB/postman doorstep DLC; bank doorstep service. Physical LC at the bank in November is still allowed; Jeevan Pramaan is optional.
Steps: 1. Install 'AadhaarFaceRd' (UIDAI) and the 'Jeevan Pramaan Face App' from the Play Store / App Store. 2. Open Jeevan Pramaan; on 'Operator Authentication' tick Aadhaar, then enter the Aadhaar number, mobile number and email, and submit. 3. Enter the pension details (PPO number, bank account, disbursing agency) and do a face scan. 4. An SMS with the Jeevan Pramaan ID confirms success; the bank fetches the DLC online. The PDF can be downloaded from jeevanpramaan.gov.in using the ID.

- 85 to less than 90: 30%

query: विधवा पेंशन कितनी मिलती है और कैसे आवेदन करें?
golden:
Answer: Under the central Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS, part of NSAP), a widow from a BPL household gets central assistance of Rs 300 per month from age 40 (40-79 years). From age 80 this rises to Rs 500 per month. States/UTs add their own top-up, and many run their own widow pension schemes, so the amount actually received varies by State. NSAP gives the central share only. Payment is by DBT to the beneficiary's bank/post office account.
Steps (how to apply): 1. Apply to the State/UT department that implements NSAP, through the Gram Panchayat/Block (rural) or the Municipality (urban). This is mostly the Social Welfare Department; it differs by State (e.g. Rural Development in AP/Assam/WB, Revenue in Karnataka/TN). The State form is free; many States also take online applications on their own portals. 2. Attach proof of age (birth/school certificate, else ration card/EPIC or a Govt Medical Officer's certificate), proof of widowhood (husband's death certificate showing the widow's name, or a certificate from the designated Revenue Authority), BPL status, and bank/Aadhaar details. 3. Verification (about 15 days), then discussion in the Gram Sabha/Ward Sabha, then a sanction order by the Sanctioning Authority. The total time from receipt to sanction or rejection should not exceed 60 days, and appeal is possible if rejected. 4. Track the status on nsap.dord.gov.in (Track Application).

query: What is the Unified Pension Scheme and who can opt for it?
golden:
Answer: The Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is an option under NPS for Central Government employees. It was notified by the Ministry of Finance on 24.01.2025 (F. No. FX-1/3/2024-PR), took effect on 1 April 2025, is regulated by PFRDA, and its rules were notified 02.09.2025. Main features:
- Contributions: employee 10% of (Basic + DA); matching Government 10%; plus about 8.5% to a pool corpus.
- Assured payout: 50% of the average basic pay of the last 12 months, for 25 or more years of qualifying service; proportionate between 10 and 25 years.
- Minimum payout: Rs 10,000 a month after at least 10 years of service.
- Family payout: 60% to the legally wedded spouse.
- Dearness Relief on both the payout and the family payout.
- Lump sum: 1/10 of (last Basic + DA) for every completed 6 months of service, plus gratuity.
- Final withdrawal: up to 60% of the corpus, which reduces the payout proportionately.
Who can opt: (a) Central Government employees covered by NPS and in service on 01.04.2025; (b) new recruits joining on or after 01.04.2025, within 30 days of joining; (c) retired NPS subscribers who superannuated/retired on or before 31.03.2025 with at least 10 years of qualifying service or under FR 56(j) (not as a penalty), or their legally wedded spouse if the retiree has died. These past retirees get arrears with PPF-rate interest. The option deadline for existing employees and past retirees was 30 November 2025 (extended from 30.06.2025, then 30.09.2025); no further extension was found on official sources as of 15 Oct 2026. Anyone who does not opt stays in NPS. UPS carries a one-time, one-way switch back to NPS.

query: What is the time limit for an RTI reply and for filing the first appeal?

query: What are the verticals under PMAY-Urban 2.0?
golden:
Answer: PMAY-Urban 2.0 has four verticals. (1) Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC): assistance to individual EWS families to build a new house of 30-45 sq m on their own land; States may give land patta to the landless; instalments are linked to geo-tagged construction stages. (2) Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP): EWS families buy/get allotted houses in projects by public/private agencies; includes Redeemable Housing Vouchers for whitelisted private projects and in-situ slum redevelopment. (3) Affordable Rental Housing (ARH): Model-1 converts existing government-funded vacant houses into rental housing; Model-2 means construct, operate and maintain rental housing by private/public entities for urban poor, working women, industrial workers etc. (4) Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS): home-loan interest subsidy for EWS/LIG/MIG, up to Rs 1.80 lakh. For BLC and AHP, central assistance is Rs 2.50 lakh/unit in NE/hill States (Rs 2.25 lakh Centre + at least Rs 0.25 lakh State) and in UTs with legislature (J&K, Puducherry, Delhi). Other UTs get Rs 2.50 lakh Centre. Other States get Rs 1.5 lakh Centre + at least Rs 1.0 lakh State. ARH gets a Technology Innovation Grant of Rs 3,000/sq m (Centre) + Rs 2,000/sq m (State). query: How do I apply for a UDID card and what disability percentage is needed?

Answer: Apply online on the UDID portal (swavlambancard.gov.in -> 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card'), or via the UDID app, camps or the CMO office. Process: (1) submit the application on the portal; (2) when status shows 'Submitted', visit the UDID/disability certification section of the hospital chosen in the application; (3) the hospital/medical authority verifies the application; (4) specialist doctor(s) assess the disability; (5) the Medical Board reviews and fixes the type and percentage of disability; (6) the medical authority generates the disability certificate and UDID card, and DEPwD dispatches the card by Speed Post. The status can be tracked on the portal. Disability percentage: no minimum percentage is needed to get a disability certificate / UDID card. DEPwD (05-07-2024) told States not to deny certificates/UDID cards to persons assessed below 40%. However, 'benchmark disability', i.e. not less than 40% of a specified disability (RPwD Act, 2016), is needed for most benefits, such as reservation and schemes for PwBD.

Get the application verified. 5. Attend the specialist assessment. 6. The Medical Board decides type and percentage. 7. The card is generated and sent by Speed Post. query: How do I register for apprenticeship after BTech and how much stipend is paid?

The candidate should ideally have no previous work experience. Stipend: the minimum monthly stipend for Graduate/Degree apprentices is Rs 12,300 (revised from Rs 9,000 under GSR 610(E) of Sept 2025). query: How do I get an Import Export Code and what is the fee? Does it need annual updating?
golden:
Answer: The IEC is a 10-character code, the same as the firm's PAN, issued by DGFT on an online application (ANF-2A) at dgft.gov.in. It is needed for import/export of goods unless exempted. For services exports it is needed only when claiming FTP benefits. Pre-requisites: firm PAN, a bank account in the firm's name, and a valid address (DGFT may verify the address physically). The applicant needs an active DSC or Aadhaar (e-sign) of the proprietor/partner/director. Fee: Rs 500, paid online via Bharatkosh. The IEC is auto-generated and sent by email/SMS, and the e-IEC can be downloaded from the dashboard. Only one IEC per PAN. The IEC has permanent validity unless suspended or cancelled, but annual updating IS required: under FTP 2023 para 2.05(d)-(e), the IEC holder must update IEC details online every year during April-June, and must confirm online even if nothing has changed. An IEC not updated in time is de-activated and can be re-activated on successful updation. Any change in constitution, address, bank or other primary details must be updated within 30 days (HBP para 2.14).
Steps: 1. Go to dgft.gov.in > Services > IEC Profile Management > 'Apply for IEC' and register/log in. 2. Fill ANF-2A (firm details, PAN with name/DOB as per PAN, address, bank, branches, contact). 3. Upload a cancelled cheque/bank certificate and address proof. 4. Sign with DSC or Aadhaar e-Sign. 5. Pay the Rs 500 fee on Bharatkosh. 6. Download the e-IEC from the dashboard. 7. Every April-June: log in and use 'Update/Modify IEC' to update or confirm the details.

Answer: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance is Rs 3,200 per month w.e.f. 01-11-2025 (previously Rs 3,000 from 01-01-2024). Eligibility: age 60 years or more; domicile and resident of Haryana; own plus spouse's income from all sources not more than Rs 3,00,000 per year. People receiving a pension from any Government, local or statutory body (or a Government-financed organisation) are excluded. The scheme is now run proactively through Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP): eligible residents are identified from PPP/FIDR data and asked for consent, and payment goes to the PPP-linked bank account. It can also be applied for on Saral Haryana ('Old Age Samman Allowance' service). Note: Saral Haryana itself does not show the amount; the amount is on the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment Haryana pages.
Behaviour: Gives the amount with the effective date and cites the SJE Haryana page/scheme PDF. If the amount cannot be shown from a source it can see, it still names the responsible State department and links its portal (G12 - named, not refused).gov.in. Gives no eligibility verdict and does not ask for a PPP/Aadhaar number.
Fail if: Says Rs 3,000 or Rs 2,750 (stale); quotes Rs 1,800 from the outdated haryana.gov.in scheme page; confuses it with the central IGNOAPS (Rs 200/500); gives an amount without a date; cites news sites.

query: What is the old age pension amount in Delhi?
golden:
Answer: The Delhi Department of Social Welfare page (Financial Assistance Schemes, last updated 14/10/2026) states the Old Age Assistance quantum as Rs 2,000 per month for ages 60-69, plus an additional Rs 500 per month for SC/ST/Minority beneficiaries, and Rs 2,500 per month for 70 years and above. Eligibility: 60+; at least 5 years' residence in Delhi; annual family income (applicant + spouse) below Rs 1,00,000; Aadhaar; a single-operated, Aadhaar-mapped bank account in Delhi; not receiving any other pension. Apply online on e-District Delhi (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in) or at the District Social Welfare Office. Applications are taken within the constituency quota and are normally decided within 45 days. Payment is monthly via PFMS from the month after the application. News reports from 2025 say the Delhi Government decided to raise this to Rs 2,500 (60-69) and Rs 3,000 (70+), but no official notification was found on delhi.gov.in, so the bot should not state the higher amounts as official.
Behaviour: Quotes the amount from the official Delhi page with the as-on date and notes that a revision was announced but is not reflected on the official page. If the amount cannot be shown from a source it can see, it still names the responsible State department and links its portal (G12 - named, not refused). No eligibility verdict.
Fail if: States Rs 2,500/Rs 3,000 as the official current rate citing news; confuses it with the central IGNOAPS amounts or the myScheme 'psoap' record (Rs 1,500/2,000, another state); omits the SC/ST/minority +Rs 500; cites news, Facebook or party websites.

query: What is the fiscal deficit target for 2026-27 in the Budget?
golden:
Answer: Union Budget 2026-27 (presented 1 Feb 2026) estimates the Centre's fiscal deficit in BE 2026-27 at 4.3% of GDP, i.e. Rs 16,95,768 crore (Budget at a Glance). For comparison: RE 2025-26 is 4.4% of GDP (Rs 15,58,492 crore), the same as BE 2025-26, and 2024-25 Actuals were 4.8%. The Government's anchor is now debt: debt-to-GDP is estimated at 55.6% in BE 2026-27 (56.1% in RE 2025-26), targeting 50±1% by 2030-31. Other BE 2026-27 figures: revenue deficit 1.5%, primary deficit 0.7% of GDP; net market borrowings from dated securities Rs 11.7 lakh crore, gross Rs 17.2 lakh crore.
Behaviour: Quotes the figure exactly as in the Budget documents with a citation (Budget Speech para 94 / Budget at a Glance).
Fail if: Says 4.4% (that is 2025-26) or 4.5% (the old glide-path target); gives a rupee figure without the % or the reverse with wrong numbers; cites news or RBI estimates instead of indiabudget.gov.in.

query: PMEGP subsidy how much for a new unit?
golden:
Answer: PMEGP = Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme, a credit-linked subsidy scheme of the Ministry of MSME implemented by KVIC (nodal agency), KVIBs, DICs and banks. For a new unit, the margin money subsidy is as follows. General category: own contribution 10% of project cost; subsidy 15% (urban) / 25% (rural). Special category (SC, ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, transgenders, differently abled, NER, Aspirational Districts, Hill and Border areas): own contribution 5%; subsidy 25% (urban) / 35% (rural). The maximum project cost eligible for subsidy is Rs 50 lakh (manufacturing) and Rs 20 lakh (business/service). The balance is a bank loan, and any cost above these caps gets no subsidy. Eligibility: individual above 18; no income ceiling; at least Class VIII pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 5 lakh (service); new projects only; one person per family (self and spouse). EDP training is required before the margin money claim. Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal). Separately, a 2nd loan for upgrading existing PMEGP/REGP/MUDRA units gets 15% subsidy (20% NER/Hill), up to Rs 15 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 3.75 lakh (service).
Behaviour: Expands PMEGP correctly and cites the myScheme 'pmegp' record. Gives no eligibility verdict.
Fail if: Uses the stale FAQ figures on the same myScheme page (maximum project cost Rs 25 lakh/Rs 10 lakh) as current; states the FAQ's 'maximum age 35/40' (not in the benefits/eligibility sections); gives subsidy as a fixed rupee amount; confuses it with PMFME or MUDRA; omits the urban/rural and category split.
